Objective: O1: Develop a High-Accuracy LSTM Deep Learning Model
Explanation (What/How): To design, train, and optimize a multivariate LSTM network using Python (TensorFlow/Keras). The model will incorporate historical price data, trading volume, and calculated technical indicators (e.g., RSI, MACD) to capture non-linear patterns and long-term dependencies in the financial time series data.

Objective: O2: Implement a Decoupled Microservice Architecture
Explanation (What/How): To build a two-tiered system where the Python ML Model is deployed as an independent RESTful microservice (using Flask/FastAPI). This service will be callable by the Next.js application, ensuring that the intensive computational load of the model is decoupled from the web application layer.

Objective: O3: Design and Develop a Next.js User Interface
Explanation (What/How): To utilize the Next.js framework to create a single-page, responsive, and performance-optimized frontend application that provides user authentication, ticker search functionality, and real-time interactive charting of predicted and historical prices.

Objective: O4: Evaluate Model Performance and Justify Superiority
Explanation (What/How): To conduct rigorous model validation, comparing the LSTM model's performance against at least one conventional statistical model (e.g., ARIMA) using standardized metrics like Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE).
